# Garmin Connect data

Range: 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21 (5 days)
Exported: 2026-10-15 20:53 (America/Guatemala)

Each file is a CSV with a header row. Local dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Column names are as Garmin returns them; the unit is in parentheses.

## Files (21)
- `activities.csv`: All activities: type, duration, distance, heart rate, calories. 4 rows, 2023-11-29 → 2024-02-14.
